risk_explanation: The certifi package is pinned to an outdated version and is not directly imported or used by the project's source code. It exists in the requirements file only as a transitive dependency of the requests library.
steps: Remove the explicit version pin for certifi from requirements.txt. This allows the requests library to resolve the most appropriate version of its own dependency.
suggested_tests: Run pytest to ensure that network-dependent tests still pass with the updated version of certifi.
